extractions.value: Patient also had history of hyperthyroidism (diagnosed 1992, treated with propylthiouracil, remained euthyroid). Neuropsychological testing showed low I.Q. and mild to moderate attention deficit. Thyroid scan showed hypertrophic multinodular gland. Axonal motor-sensory polyneuropathy found on EMG. No cutaneous silent period observed in TA muscles. Local anesthetic blockage of fibular nerve terminated spontaneous motor unit activity in right TA.
